subject: Re: POC plan & integration steps — Redwood trial for Acme
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>, Luke Harris <luke.harris@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial — Redwood integration plan

Hi Jane / Luke,

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the context on Acme's search augmentation roadmap. Per our discussion, here's a concise recap and a proposed POC scope so we can get the trial started quickly.

Highlights / success criteria (as discussed):
- Latency: 99th percentile generation latency under 300ms for 512-token prompts under the expected traffic profile.
- Cost: Token cost target of <$0.003 per generated token during the POC workload.
- Quality: Achieve >= 85% relevance on the human-rated eval set (we'll use the 200-case eval you mentioned).
- Integration: Streaming responses to your web UI + tool calling for catalog lookups + embeddings for reranking.

Proposed POC plan (2-3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week): provisioning + sandbox creds + short kickoff with your eng team.
2) Week 1: Integration — SDK quickstart, API routes, streaming demo, basic tool-call example.
3) Week 2: Eval & tuning — run eval set, tweak prompts/quantization, collect logs.
4) Week 3: Final report, performance/cost breakdown, and next-step proposal.

Ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (project owner), Aditya (SE lead for integration).
- Acme: Jane (product), Luke (engineering lead).

Technical notes / integration pointers:
- We recommend our Python SDK for rapid integration (redwood.sdk) and an HTTP fallback for serverless environments.
- Streaming: websocket or chunked HTTP responses; we'll show both in the quickstart.
- Tool calling: we can wire your catalog service to Redwood's tool-call contract (postback URL + JSON schema).
- Embeddings: endpoint available for on-demand embedding with bulk upload support.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm the primary eng contact (for sandbox credentials) and your preferred start date?
- I'll loop in Aditya (SE) with a short tech kickoff once we have a contact.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_sdk_quickstart.md (sample snippets)

Subject: RE: POC trial — Redwood integration plan (technical kickoff)

Hi Luke / Jane / Marissa,

Quick technical kickoff notes and examples to unblock integration work. I'll be available for a 30-45m pairing session next week — propose Tue/Wed morning.

1) Sandbox provisioning (what we need from Acme):
- Callback URL(s) for tool-calls (https endpoints).
- IP allowlist (if you prefer IP restriction).
- A short-lived API key for sandbox (we can generate from our console once you confirm OOO).

2) Tool calling example (postback contract):
- Redwood will POST to your callback with JSON: {"task_id": "string", "input": {"query": "string"}, "metadata": {"request_id": "string"}}
- Your service should return 200 with JSON: {"task_id": "string", "result": {...}} within 5s for low-latency flows.
- We'll include authentication header: Authorization: Bearer <signed-token> (we'll share verification steps).

3) SDK / API routes (quickstart snippets):
- Python (recommended for server-side):
  from redwood import RedwoodClient
  client = RedwoodClient(api_key="<SANDBOX_KEY>")
  # streaming example
  with client.stream.chat(model="xlarge-2026") as stream:
      for chunk in stream.prompt("Search query: ..."):
          render(chunk.text)

- HTTP (chunked transfer encoding) for browser-friendly streaming. We can share an Express/Cloud Function sample.

4) Tool calling (high-level):
- Define tool schema in the console (name, input schema, callback URL).
- Redwood will surface the tool during decoding; on selection we fire the postback.

5) Telemetry & logs:
- We'll provide per-request trace ids. For the POC we can retain full token-level logs for debugging; production retention will be configurable.

6) Next steps / checklist for Luke:
- Provide callback URL + IP allowlist (if any).
- Drop the eval set in the Drive folder.
- Confirm a 30-45m time for pairing (Tue/Wed preferred).

I've attached a short SDK quickstart (redwood_sdk_quickstart.md) with runnable snippets.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call to walk through.

— Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
